mentions.name: Math Can Be A Hobby
mentions.description: A YouTube lecture series working through Serge Lang's Basic Mathematics, produced as deliberate teaching practice while the creator retrains to become a schoolteacher; the first video has earned 350k+ views and is still growing.
mentions.problem: The creator is switching from software to a schoolteaching career and uses the channel to deliberately practice teaching and refresh math skills.
mentions.source_excerpt:
“Math Can Be A Hobby”, lecture series based on Serge Lang’s Basic Mathematics. Unexpected breakout success, 350k+ views on 1st video and rising.
https://youtube.com/@MathCanBeAHobby
